sources.title: LoRA & QLoRA GPU Memory Calculator - RTSALL
sources.snippet: 1. How to Use the Calculator Select a Base Model: Choose a preset model or define custom parameters (Hidden Dimension, Layers, and Total Params). Choose Quantization: Select 16-bit for standard LoRA, or 8-bit/4-bit for QLoRA. Lower precision directly shrinks base model VRAM footprint.

sources.title: Memory footprint during QLoRA training - theneuralbase.com
sources.snippet: QLoRA reduces memory usage by quantizing the base model to 4-bit and training only small adapter layers, letting you fine-tune 7B+ parameter models on consumer GPUs.
